scientific_limitations: The result classifies only the rational automorphism character in bidegree (3,4) for the standard Möbius–Kantor graph. No integral third-homology torsion or other bidegrees are determined; an equivalent unindexed earlier calculation remains possible.
title: The 96-symmetry magnitude-homology character of the Möbius–Kantor graph
